component: Thunderbird CSS parser test reference collection

quotes.text: info("custom property `" + prop + "` is not referenced");

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The landing replaces regular-expression extraction with InspectorCSSParser token handling in processCSSRules. It counts style()/var() custom-property references, records custom-property declarations and collects non-data URL values for the later resource checks. The test then applies property-name/source exceptions separately from CSS error allowances, and unreferenced properties only produce info output. This is scoped test bookkeeping, not a dependency-graph proof, CSS-engine correctness result or visual compatibility check; no test was run.
title: The CSS test uses lexer tokens to collect references, while unused properties stay informational
